name: Talon Twig
description: Stab a hooked twig of qi like a hawk's talon into the soft gap under the opponent's arm.

name: Azure Leaf
description: Ride a broad leaf of blue-green qi through a short glide to a better footing.

name: Sky Bark
description: Raise a pale layer of bark qi over the head and shoulders against a blow from above.

name: Stoop Bough
description: Fold the body and bring a limb of qi down on the opponent from above like a stooping hawk.

name: Hawk Vine
description: Throw a vine with a hooked end that catches the opponent's shoulder and hauls them forward.

name: Feather Leaf
description: Spread a wide leaf like a wing to turn a thrust and spin the user out of its line.

name: Diving Branch
description: Drop from height with a spear-straight branch of qi braced under the lead arm.

name: Azure Crown
description: Spread a crown of dense blue-green leaves above the user to turn aside blows and falling things.

name: Hawkwood Descent
description: Rise on a column of grown limbs and fall with the whole tree driving the hooked point through guard and body.

name: Twin Pith
description: Link two palms to an ally's chest and back and read the heart and breath together.

name: Heartwood Rap
description: Rap hardened heartwood knuckles against the opponent's ribs and send the shock through them.

name: Paired Rind
description: Wear two layers of rind qi on the guard arms so one takes the blow and one holds.

name: Heartwood Mend
description: Guide steady heartwood qi into an ally's torn side to draw the wound together.

name: Pair Knot
description: Tie two knots of qi round the opponent's wrists so the hands bind each other.

name: Twinsap Draw
description: Draw sap qi through both trunks of the body to raise a hurt ally from kneeling to standing.

name: Heartwood Bash
description: Bring both fists down together onto a guard in a bash of grown heartwood.

name: Double Heartwood
description: Stand inside two interlocked cores of heartwood qi that spread each blow between them.

name: Twinsap Surge
description: Run strong sap qi through both the user and an ally so both fight with the same rested strength.

name: Heartwood Rebirth
description: Drive new heartwood qi into a person whose breath has just stopped to restart the heart within moments.

name: Cool Sip
description: Gather cool damp qi in the palm and let a tired ally drink it back to alertness.

name: Springwood Mend
description: Let clear spring qi run through an ally's cut and wash it closed.

name: Spring Root
description: Draw up a thick root of damp qi under the feet that cushions a hard shove.

name: Rich Tonic
description: Pour a rich tonic of stored qi into a spent ally so strength returns in a few breaths.

name: Quench Leaf
description: Lay a quenching leaf on a poisoned ally to soak the venom up and out through the skin.

name: Spring Lash
description: Whip a jet of hard-packed spring qi and leaves across the opponent's face.

name: Springtree Draught
description: Pour a great draught of clean living qi into a badly hurt ally and close open wounds.

name: Waterroot Sense
description: Send deep roots down to the water below and feel the breathing of every living thing near it.

name: Purifying Bloom
description: Open a great bloom over allies that drinks poison and curse and backlash out of every body beneath it.

name: Blossom Cut
description: Cut a shallow arc with a hand edged by a petal of hard qi.

name: Petal Pair
description: Spin two razor petals of qi at the opponent from either hand.

name: Bloom Guard
description: Open a flower of overlapping petals before the chest that closes over a strike.

name: Blossom Snare
description: Close a bloom of soft petals about the opponent's limbs that clamps shut when they struggle.

name: Petal Storm
description: Whirl a blizzard of razor petals around the user that cuts everything within reach.

name: Bloom Step
description: Burst into petals at one spot and open again a short way off.

name: Blossom Reap
description: Sweep a wide scythe of petal-edged qi across the opponent's middle in one pass.

name: Hundred Petals
description: Scatter a hundred cutting petals that spiral down on a wide front.

name: Falling Blossom
description: Gather a vast cloud of blossoms overhead and let it fall as a veil of cutting petals.

name: Willow Ripple
description: Send a rippling lash of willow qi along the arm into the opponent's guard.

name: Reed Cross
description: Step across on a bridge of bundled reeds of qi that forms and fades underfoot.

name: Willow Dip
description: Dip the whole body under a strike like a bough bowing to the water.

name: Weeping Mend
description: Let a fall of cool willow qi drip onto an ally's wounds and soak them closed.

name: Willow Coil
description: Wind long supple strands about the opponent in loop after loop until they cannot lift an arm.

name: Drift Strand
description: Float drifting strands before the opponent's eyes until the user's true position is lost.

name: Trailing Whip
description: Trail a long whip behind a sweeping step and flick it round to hit from behind.

name: Willow Flood
description: Loose a surging wave of lashing strands that sweeps across the whole front.

name: Streaming Veil
description: Let long streaming strands flow down round the user and carry blows away to the sides.

name: Weeping Torrent
description: Bring down a torrent of huge willow strands that crushes and drags all within its fall.

name: Azure Bud
description: Cup a blue-green bud of qi over an ally's wound and let it open and seal the flesh.

name: Bloom Fist
description: Open a closed fist at the moment of contact in a burst of blue-green qi.

name: Bud Shield
description: Hold a tight bud of qi before the body that swells hard against a blow.

name: Unbroken Stem
description: Grow a tough green stem along the spine that regrows every time a blow breaks it.

name: Bloom Lash
description: Snap a flowering vine out from the shoulder that opens against the opponent's body.

name: Azure Pollen
description: Puff a cloud of blue pollen qi that fogs the opponent's senses and slows the hands.

name: Unbroken Bloom
description: Keep a bloom opening over an ally's body that heals again each time the flesh is hurt.

name: Azure Thorn
description: Thrust a single great blue thorn through the opponent's guard and into their body.

name: Azure Flowerfall
description: Open one enormous blue flower of qi that blooms outward and cuts everything in its opening.

name: Oath Pinetip
description: Cast a fine hard needle of pine qi along a flat unwavering line.

name: Pinebark Guard
description: Hold a flaking plate of pinebark qi on the arm that sheds the force of a cut.

name: Swornsway
description: Lean into the wind and take a long sworn step along its line.

name: Needle Sweep
description: Brush a sweep of loose needles across a short front like a pine shaken in a gale.

name: Sworn Resin
description: Smear sworn resin qi on the opponent's meridian points so their qi sticks and slows.

name: Wind Pine
description: Bend with the blow like a pine in a gale and let the force run past along the trunk.

name: Needlegale
description: Shake a whole bough and send thousands of hardened needles screaming forward on the wind.

name: Swornpine
description: Stand as a sworn pine that holds its place through a gale of strikes.

name: Oathpine Fall
description: Fell the whole oath pine on the opponent along a single sworn line.

name: Gale Bough
description: Swing a stout bough of qi hard on the wind across the opponent's front.

name: Rootstone Brace
description: Clamp roots of qi round the rock underfoot and stand against the push of the gale.

name: Scour Leaf
description: Throw a handful of gale-scoured leaves that sting like grit across the opponent's eyes.

name: Windlash Bough
description: Whip the bough back on the wind and return it in a second cut.

name: Rockside Twist
description: Twist a stout branch of qi into the opponent's lead arm and spoil the line of their blow.

name: Bough Anchor
description: Hold the opponent's feet with heavy roots of qi sunk into the ground.

name: Gale Heal
description: Breathe a brisk healing wind of green qi over an ally that closes cuts and clears the head.

name: Scouring Bough
description: Bring the great bough round in a wide sweep that scours the ground clear.

name: Stonebind Roots
description: Raise a thicket of rock-gripping roots that wraps the opponent and holds them through the gale.

name: Galebough Rend
description: Swing the full weight of the great bough with the gale behind it and tear through guard and body.

name: Skyward Sprig
description: Fling a straight hard sprig of qi up and over the opponent's guard.

name: Open Bark
description: Show a plain layer of bark qi to the blow and hide nothing behind it.

name: Sunleaf Draw
description: Spread leaves of qi to the sun and feed the warmth into an ally's tired limbs.

name: Oath Limb
description: Swing a sworn limb of qi straight at the opponent in the open and never turn it aside.

name: Lone Root
description: Drive a lone deep root through the user's feet so no force can move the stance.

name: Sunbough Mend
description: Hold an ally in plain sight under spreading green boughs that knit the wounds beneath.

name: Skyroot Strike
description: Drive a huge root of qi from the ground up through the opponent's guard in one thrust.

name: Oath Crown
description: Raise a vast crown of boughs above the user that the sky itself seems to press upon in vain.

name: Oathtree Rising
description: Raise a towering oath tree that presses every enemy near it to the ground beneath its boughs.

name: Cedar Jab
description: Jab a fist soaked in fragrant cedar qi into the opponent's chest.

name: Cedar Bark
description: Wrap the forearms in long fibrous cedar bark that smothers a blow.

name: Cedar Salve
description: Smooth the sharp resin of cedar qi over an ally's scrape to close it and keep out taint.

name: Bearing Cedar
description: Hold a fixed bearing like a tall cedar and let every strike slide off its straight trunk.

name: Cedar Wind
description: Send a clean cedar wind through an ally's body to blow out poison and curse.

name: Cedar Lance
description: Thrust a long lance of cedar qi down the held bearing and into the opponent.

name: Cedar Pillar
description: Stand as a great cedar pillar that no gust of blows can bend off its bearing.

name: Cedar Rebuke
description: Lay a heavy cedar limb across the opponent's qi so their strikes weaken for a time.

name: Cedar Judgement
description: Bring a cedar trunk down along a fixed bearing in a single stroke no guard turns.

name: Bamboo Snap
description: Bend a cane of qi to the limit and snap it into the opponent's guard.

name: Cane Brace
description: Brace the body behind a row of tough canes of qi that bend under the blow.

name: Gust Bow
description: Bow at the waist before a gust of blows and straighten once they have passed.

name: Bamboo Pulse
description: Tap a hollow cane of qi on the ground and read the answering stir of every foot nearby.

name: Sworn Cane
description: Spring a sworn cane out of the bend with a double crack.

name: Cane Lock
description: Clamp a jointed cane of qi about the opponent's limb and lock the joint straight.

name: Caneflow
description: Feed life through a hollow cane of qi into an ally's body like water through a pipe.

name: Cane Rush
description: Spring a hundred canes at once from the ground in a rush that bursts through a wide front.

name: Bamboo Rebound
description: Take a heavy blow into a bent cane and return it in a sworn snap.

name: Sworn Bamboo
description: Spring up from the deepest bow in a straight bamboo stroke that splits what it meets.

name: Windward Root
description: Throw roots of qi forward into the wind and brace behind them.

name: Taproot Spear
description: Spear a thin hard root from the ground at the opponent's shin.

name: Risen Sap
description: Draw up strong sap qi through the earth and pass it into an ally's legs.

name: Root Drag
description: Drag the opponent along the ground by a root wrapped about the waist.

name: Wind Tangle
description: Tangle the gale itself in a net of fine roots and fling it back in the opponent's face.

name: Deepsap Mend
description: Draw up life from deep roots and send it into an ally's body to repair torn muscle.

name: Rootstorm
description: Break a storm of roots from the ground that thrash across a wide front.

name: Deep Anchor
description: Sink a mass of roots deep into the earth until the user cannot be moved by any force.

name: Deeproot Surge
description: Call up the roots of the whole ground to heave and burst in one great upward surge.
